tickets.title: Sonic even placement across presets, with a recorded verdict per report
tickets.what: Owner 2026-11-24: sonic should balance across its presets like imp's even mode (pool: deepseek, haiku, luna in ~/.hud/roles/sonic.json), and the engineering work should collect data to compare the models' results against DeepSeek. (1) Placement: add `sonicPlacement` (`fixed` default | `even`) and `sonicEvenPool` to settings (src/settings.ts, same validation as `impPlacement`/`impEvenPool`), reuse `pickEvenPreset` (src/mcp/imp-routing.ts) with the history of sonic starts in the last 24 h, for every sonic launch path (hud_create role sonic, `scout`, `hud_sonic` from workers). Record `route.placement: "even"` and `route.preset` on the job as imp does; retries keep the chosen preset. Settings → Models gets a Sonic placement row and a Sonic even pool row like imp's. Sonic still accepts no placement fields from callers. (2) Verdict: the main session can record how good a settled sonic report was, when it reads it: `hud_read({job, verdict: "ok" | "partial" | "wrong", verdict_note?})` on a sonic job writes `verdict {value, note, at}` into the job record once (a second call replaces it, last write wins) and changes nothing else; non-sonic jobs return invalid_arguments. The panel does not show it. Job archive keeps it. This is a fact for toktrack's model comparison; HUD does no analysis. Update docs/reference.md (EN; ZH by the translation pass) and the hud-delegate skill's sonic line with one sentence on recording a verdict. Budget about 150 source lines and 4 tests.

acceptance.text: With sonicPlacement even and pool [deepseek, haiku, luna], consecutive sonic creates and scouts pick the preset with the fewest sonic starts in 24 h, ties in role-file order; the choice is on the job record
An unavailable or exhausted preset is skipped and reported, as for imp
hud_read with verdict on a settled sonic job records it in the job record and archive; on a non-sonic job it is refused
Settings → Models shows and edits Sonic placement and Sonic even pool
docs/reference.md and the hud-delegate skill updated

comments.author: owner change (main session)
comments.text: `even` is a plain round-robin rotator per role (state file under HUD_HOME with the last index; next available preset in pool order, wrapping; unavailable ones skipped and reported), shared by imp and sonic; it replaces imp's "fewest starts in the last 24 hours" counting, whose code and tests are deleted. The first acceptance item reads "consecutive sonic creates and scouts take the pool's presets in turn".

tickets.title: Even rotation survives quota exhaustion and the bars say which preset left
tickets.what: Owner 2026-11-24: `even` needs break protection. (1) When a launch on the rotated preset fails with a quota failure (`isQuotaFailure`, today's `markExhausted` path), the place is marked exhausted as now and the same job moves on to the next available preset in the pool (the rotator's order) instead of failing; the job record keeps `route.preset` as the preset that actually ran and lists the skipped one with its reason. (2) An exhausted preset leaves the rotation until its exhaustion mark expires, then rejoins without any action. (3) Notice zone: while any preset of an even pool (imp or sonic) is out of the rotation, the bottom bars (Claude/Antigravity statusline, pi footer, Codex tmux bar; docs/reference.md "The bottom bars") show one notice item after open approvals and before HUD load, e.g. `⚠ imp fast: quota` (several: the first plus `+N`), gone when it rejoins. Text and Nerd icon sets get their own glyph as other items do. This is the only new notice item for now; others come later.

acceptance.text: A fixture where the rotated preset's launch fails with a quota error starts the same job on the next preset in the pool; the exhausted preset is skipped by later launches until its mark expires, then used again

The notice item appears in all bar looks while a pool preset is exhausted and disappears after it rejoins (tests on the TypeScript renderer; the native statusline falls back to TypeScript or renders the same item)
docs/reference.md (even paragraph and the notice zone list) updated

tickets.title: Sonic reports get an automatic citation check instead of a verdict
tickets.what: Owner 2026-11-24: neither the main session nor the worker should judge a sonic report. (The verdict parameters were dropped during the sonic-even/01 land repair; verify none remain.) When a sonic job settles with a report, HUD checks the report's citations mechanically and records the facts on the job record and archive as `citations {total, verified, failed: [{ref, reason}] (at most 20)}`: a citation is `path:line` or `path:line-line` (relative to the job cwd or absolute); it is verified when the file exists inside the job's cwd or worktree, the line range exists, and, when the report quotes text in backticks on the same row, that text (whitespace-normalised) appears within ±3 lines. No model call, no network; bounded work (stop after 200 citations; a report over 256 KiB is checked on its first 256 KiB). Reports without citations record `total: 0`. HUD does no analysis; toktrack groups by model later. The panel does not show it.

acceptance.text: No `verdict` parameter, job field or doc sentence exists (grep check)
A fixture sonic report with three citations (one correct, one with a wrong line, one with a quote that is not there) records total 3, verified 1 and two failures with reasons
The check runs once per settled report, adds no model call, and finishes within 100 ms on a 256 KiB report in the test
docs/reference.md describes the recorded `citations` facts in one paragraph

tickets.title: Citation check resolves the paths sonic actually cites
tickets.what: sonic-even/03's check (`src/roles/sonic-citations.ts`) verifies 1,452 of 15,203 recorded citations (979 sonic jobs, 2026-11-25); 7,962 failures are `missing_file`, so the numbers say more about the checker than about sonic. Samples of missing_file (cwd | ref): `~/projects/MyHUD-wt/imp-338bdc | src/render/main-tabs.ts:3-17` (a worktree path; prewalk scouts may run before their imp's worktree exists, or the check may run after it is removed), `~/projects/toktrack | store.rs:294`, `usage.rs:447`, `app.rs:3356-3362`, `MyHUD-wt/imp-2b2873 | main.rs:245-250` (bare basenames), `MyHUD | owner-64b.txt:495` (a scratch file outside the repo). First measure: classify all current missing_file failures in ~/.hud/jobs by cause (cwd missing at check time, cwd differs from where the sonic actually read, basename/partial path, genuinely absent) and put the counts in the report. Then fix the checker's root causes: check against the directory the sonic actually worked in, at settlement, and resolve a bare or partial path only when exactly one tracked file (`git ls-files` in that root) matches; ambiguous or absent stays a failure with its own reason (e.g. `ambiguous_path`). Keep bounded work (200 citations, 256 KiB, no model, no network) and the record shape `citations {total, verified, failed[] (max 20)}`; new reasons are additive. Do not rewrite old job records.

acceptance.text: Report lists missing_file causes with counts over the existing job records
Fixture: a citation by unique basename verifies; one matching two tracked files fails as ambiguous_path; a prewalk scout whose cited files are in the repo root verifies
Check still adds no model call and finishes within 100 ms on a 256 KiB report (existing test)
docs/reference.md citations paragraph names the resolution rule and the new reason

tickets.title: Sonic jobs record how much tool output they read
tickets.what: Owner 2026-11-25 wants to estimate sonic cost/benefit: the main session's saving is roughly the tool output sonic read instead of main. toktrack does the analysis (HUD records facts only, no Insights). When a sonic job settles, record on the job record and archive `reads {tool_calls, tool_result_bytes, by_tool {name: {calls, bytes}} (top 10)}` counted from the sonic's own pi session (headless `sonic-session.jsonl`, or the tab session file), plus `brief_bytes` and `report_bytes`. Bounded: stream the session once, stop counting after 50 MiB with `truncated: true`; no model call. Missing or unreadable session records `reads: null` with no error. Does not change panel output.

acceptance.text: Fixture headless sonic session with three tool calls records tool_calls 3, the exact summed result bytes, by_tool counts, brief_bytes and report_bytes on job.json and the archive record
Tab-mode sonic fixture records the same from its session file; missing session gives reads null
docs/reference.md describes the fields in one paragraph; toktrack-facing archive schema note updated if one exists
